description: Record the known PR #168 defects the verification tasks will exercise (do not patch except where a task says so)
steps: TUI PANIC (blocking, has its own fix task): interactive fx panics 'thread N panic: attempt to use null value' (exit 134) whenever the OpenAI-compatible provider is active. Backtrace: src/gateway/openai_compatible_models.zig:20 configFromContext <- :35 fetchCatalog <- src/core/gateway/model_catalog.zig:144 fetch <- :182/:171 fetchWithPublicFallback <- src/core/app/model_cache_runtime.zig:625 preloadThreadMain. Cause: src/main.zig:1789 and :1806 pass builtin_providers.modelCatalog(provider) to the TUI catalog preload with provider.context == null for .openai; the CLI path src/core/cli/cli_surface.zig:1219-1221 sets provider.context = @ptrCast(@alignCast(&startup.openAiCompatibleConfig())) first, which is why fx models and fx ask work. Controls: stock 0.0.5 TUI fine; PR TUI fine in gateway mode; FX_DISABLE_KEYCHAIN=1 does not help; env-only, persisted provider, and openai_model-only configs all panic
P1 (unfixed upstream, do not patch): the Chat Completions read path has no cancellation watcher (Escape may not abort a streaming turn); the Responses path has one
P1 (unfixed upstream, do not patch): a bare SSE EOF with no finish_reason is committed as a successful turn

Gap: the chat SSE handler does not inspect a top-level 'error' key in data events (OpenRouter mid-stream errors); HTTP-level errors ARE handled — verified: a bad model id yields exit 1 and 'fx ask: API request failed · HTTP 400 · <model> is not a valid model ID'

Chat SSE parser requires 'data: ' with a trailing space (both providers send it); comment lines starting with ':' are skipped (OpenRouter keepalives are safe); chunks are parsed as dynamic std.json.Value so Groq's extra fields are tolerated; tool_call argument deltas are appended per index, so Groq's single-delta and OpenRouter's fragmented form both work (verified end to end)

description: Fix the TUI catalog-preload null-context panic (the only source change this ledger allows)
steps: Reproduce first: H=$(mktemp -d); W=$(mktemp -d); cd $W && git init -q; tmux new -d -s panic -x 120 -y 30 -c $W; tmux send-keys -t panic "env -u AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY -u VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN -u FX_PROVIDER HOME=$H OPENAI_API_KEY=x FX_OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 FX_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-120b FX_SKIP_ONBOARDING=1 ~/src/fx-openai-compat/zig-out/bin/fx 2>$W/err; echo EXIT=\$? >> $W/err" Enter; sleep 8; cat $W/err | tail -3 — expect 'panic: attempt to use null value' and EXIT=134 (the panic does not need a valid key; it happens in the catalog preload thread)

Read src/gateway/openai_compatible_models.zig lines 19-22 (configFromContext does raw.?), src/main.zig lines 1780-1810 (TUI preload gets builtin_providers.modelCatalog(provider) with context null), and src/core/cli/cli_surface.zig lines 1215-1225 (the working pattern: provider.context = @ptrCast(@alignCast(&openai_config)) where openai_config = startup.openAiCompatibleConfig())

Apply the SMALLEST fix, preferring the main.zig side: when the selected provider is .openai, set the catalog provider's .context to a pointer to a config obtained from the same startup state the CLI uses (the config value must outlive the preload thread — store it in the app/self struct, not on the stack). Acceptable alternative if that is not small: make configFromContext return a config resolved from openai_transport.resolveOpenAiBaseUrlFromSettings/ApiStyle when raw is null, or make fetchCatalog return .{ .failure = .{ .category = .runtime } } on null context (catalog unavailable, TUI still starts). Do not touch anything else
Run: ~/.local/lib/zig-0.16.0/zig fmt src/ && ~/.local/lib/zig-0.16.0/zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe && git diff > ~/src/fx-openai-compat.local.patch && git diff --stat (expect 1-2 files)

Verify no regression: fx ask --yolo --no-save 'Reply with exactly: STILL_OK' under the same env prints STILL_OK; re-run the two fake e2e tests (5 pass); grep -E 'pass,' from a fresh zig build test run shows no new failing test names
If the fix is not achievable in a small, obviously-correct patch: stop, report the exact obstacle, and propose PR #324 as fallback — do not ship an interactive launcher that panics

description: Groq: raw streamed tool call shape (single-delta) and the tool_choice pitfall
steps: Tool: {"type":"function","function":{"name":"get_test_value","description":"Return the test value for a key","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"key":{"type":"string"}},"required":["key"]}}}

Run with the Groq env: POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions with model openai/gpt-oss-120b, stream:true, tool_choice:"auto", the tool, and user message 'Call get_test_value with key alpha.' — save the SSE

Verify: exactly one tool_calls delta carrying index 0, id (fc_<uuid> style, no call_ prefix), function.name get_test_value and the COMPLETE arguments JSON containing alpha; finish_reason tool_calls; ends with 'data: [DONE]'; no lines starting with ':'; every data line is 'data: ' with a space

Negative control (do not skip): same request with tool_choice:"required" and the prompt 'Say hello, nothing else.' → HTTP 400 with code tool_use_failed. fx sends tool_choice auto by default (first_call_tool_choice = .auto), so this must never be changed to required
Informational: Groq chunks carry non-OpenAI fields x_groq, delta.channel, delta.reasoning and usage timing keys; non-streaming replies carry message.reasoning
